oracle: Decimal precision=100 on exact exported FP32 values; FP32 rounding before ranking
oracle_scope: six correctness cases, not large timing matrix

timing_scopes.search_samples_ms: four fixed independent query vectors through full prebuilt search, including filtering/selection/materialization
timing_scopes.kernel_samples_ms: four queries/corpus; arithmetic controls only; precomputed record norms for cosine; actual scalar/auto primitive for dot
timing_scopes.construction_ms: one separate observation; not search latency

sample_semantics: 7 repeated batches of 4 fixed queries; not 28 independent requests; no stable p99 claim
limitations: candidate kernels are arithmetic controls, not replacement indexes
kernel timings are not end-to-end candidate speedups
host load is not isolated; simultaneous research builds may affect directional timings
